This letter is the Attorney General's order on your petition for disclosure
of records under the Oregon Public Records Law, ORS 192.410 to 192.505.
Your petition, which we received on June 1, 19941
, asks the Attorney General
to direct the Oregon Board of Dentistry to make available for inspection and
produce copies of the following records:
1. A list of the name(s) and addresses(es) of each current Board
member.
2. Records listing the name of all current Board committees, the name
of each committee member, the current schedule for all future committee
meetings.
1 We appreciate your extending the time within which the law would have
otherwise obligated us to respond.
Michael F. Gordon
Page 2
June 21, 1994
3. All policies, policy statements, procedures, standards, criteria,
protocols, directives, rulings, and regulations currently in effect or under
consideration by the Board or its committees (excluding those already published
as Oregon Administrative Rules or Oregon Revised Statutes), which implement,
interpret, prescribe, describe or otherwise relate to the operation of the Board,
the licensing and discipline of licensees, the investigation and prosecution of
alleged violations of the Dental Practice Act, or the regulation of the practice of
dentistry or dental hygiene.
4. Minutes of the following Board meetings:
January 25-27, 1990
November 9, 1991
December 20, 1991
January 25, 1992
December 11, 1992
January 15, 1993
February 5, 1993
5. Minutes of all meetings of all Board committees from January 1,
1990, to date.
For the reasons that follow, we respectfully deny your petition because it
is moot.
We have been advised by the Executive Director of the Oregon Board of
Dentistry, Betty Reynolds, in regard to your request numbers 1 and 4 that
copies of the records sought will be provided to you promptly upon receipt by
the Board of your prepayment in an amount "reasonably calculated to reimburse
it for its actual cost in making [copies of the public records] available." ORS
192.440(3). We have been advised by Ms. Reynolds that she is preparing a
letter to you to advise you of the Board's estimated costs for making these
records available.
Michael F. Gordon
Page 3
June 21, 1994
We have been advised further by Ms. Reynolds in regard to your request
numbers 2, 3, and 5 that copies of the records sought will be provided to you
and that in regard to each of these requests, the Board will advise you of the
amount it has calculated its likely actual costs will be in making these records
available, the time within which you may expect to receive the requested
records upon prepayment of the Board's costs and the basis upon wh.ich these
calculations rest. We are advised by Ms. Reynolds that she is preparing such a
letter to you.
Since the Board has agreed to your requests for disclosure of public
records, your petition is respectfully denied as moot.
